description: This file defines the CipherMethod interface in the AWS SDK for PHP, outlining methods for cryptographic cipher operations such as obtaining cipher names, managing initialization vectors, and handling padding and stream seeking.

classes.name: CipherMethod
classes.description: Interface for cryptographic cipher methods defining necessary operations for encryption schemes within AWS SDK.

methods.name: getOpenSslName
methods.description: Returns an OpenSSL-recognizable identifier for the cipher method.

methods.name: getAesName
methods.description: Returns the AES-specific name for the cipher method.

methods.name: getCurrentIv
methods.description: Returns the current initialization vector (IV) used in encryption or decryption.

methods.name: requiresPadding
methods.description: Indicates whether the cipher requires padding for the last block.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Adjusts the IV position to reflect a seek operation within the encryption stream.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the IV based on the last ciphertext block processed.
